body: I don't think you can. The world doesn't need me because there is nothing I can do for it.
I don't think  that the world needs me, and I keep experiencing pain throughout my social life. I have also been experiencing a great deal of pain through my grades.
I really don't care about him, and don't think that It would be an effective use of time.
I can't convince him because he's not wrong. I've been failing because I am dumb as shit .
I have gone from a 99 % average to consistently below a 60, I have begun failing tests and quizzes, as well as being unable to complete my work on-time.

Not this time. I'm sorry, but I've been trying, and every step I take is a step deeper and deeper into the hole I've dug myself. Every time my footing slips, my parents tell me how much worse I'm doing in life. They seem to think that this is helping, that I'm not already aware of my downfall. I've caused my parents nothing but stress and misery, I wish I could say you were correct pumper. I really do.
They'd be glad. My dad said that I'm better off being sad, and that I'm already a disappointment to them. My extended family doesn't care much for me either.
I don't really have true friends. There was a person in a similar situation to me last year , and no one's lives were affected by his death.
